newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Macquarie breaks to new high on results.
newsitem.headline: Macquarie breaks to new high on results.

text.p: Shares in investment banking group Macquarie Bank Ltd jumped 25 cents or over 2.5 percent to a new high of A$9.75 in active early Tuesday trade after it announced stronger than expected annual profits on Monday.
Macquarie's net profit for the year to March 31 jumped 25.4 percent to A$116.94 million, producing a return on average shareholder funds or equity of 25.2 percent.
Analysts had forecast a net profit of around A$105 million.
Macquarie touched its previous April 23 high of A$9.60 on Monday, but broke through that high against a weaker market overall in early trade after wider coverage of the result.
"It would certainly be on their results," said one Melbourne dealer.
"People are also seeing they get most of their profits from fees and that they're not being hit by this margin squeeze like the other banks," the dealer said.
"This big rise in the market and the strong volumes are also positives," he said.
Macquarie's shares have now risen 50 percent since their July 29 compliance listing.
